description: This file defines the internal class AdoNetStreamFailureHandler, which implements the IStreamFailureHandler interface. It handles stream delivery failures by attempting to move messages to dead letters, with logging for success and failure cases.

classes.name: AdoNetStreamFailureHandler
classes.description: Handles stream delivery failures by moving messages to dead letters and logging the process.

methods.name: OnDeliveryFailure
methods.description: Handles delivery failure by invoking OnFailureAsync.

methods.name: OnSubscriptionFailure
methods.description: Handles subscription failure by invoking OnFailureAsync.

methods.name: OnFailureAsync
methods.description: Performs the core logic of moving a failed message to dead letters and logs the outcome.

methods.name: LogMovedMessage
methods.description: Logs a warning when a message is successfully moved to dead letters.

methods.name: LogFailedToMoveMessage
methods.description: Logs an error when moving a message to dead letters fails.
